column1: # P1.5r mutgate spec — manifest ABI pins at 8.0, the named fixture exemption, the two ABI text probes.
# Each row breaks THE BEHAVIOUR ITS ROW NAMES and must turn that row's test red.
# Tests, and whether they compile AILANG:
#   check_fixtures.py --abi-pins      rule 2 of check_abi_version alone (the pin sweep). Python, no AILANG.
#   evidence/P1.5r/run_abi_probes.sh  the two probe blocks sliced out of the COMMITTED
#                                     run_declared_vs_performed.sh by marker. grep, no AILANG.
#   evidence/P1.1/p11_core_check.sh   `ailang test` of admission.ail in a THROWAWAY WORKSPACE built from the
#                                     cwd's src/ and ABI package; it never reads ailang.lock, so a clone does
#                                     not resolve the primary checkout's packages (the ailang.lock trap).
# NO PIPES IN A test_cmd (mutgate.sh's `set -o pipefail` + `grep -q` = exit 141, a baseline red). Each row
# writes a log and greps the FILE.

column4: python3 tools/profile_definition/check_fixtures.py --abi-pins > /tmp/p15r_exemption_removed.log 2>&1; grep -qF "✓ exempted, a fixture literal built to differ: src/eval/journal/admission.ail:993" /tmp/p15r_exemption_removed.log
python3 tools/profile_definition/check_fixtures.py --abi-pins > /tmp/p15r_exemption_stale.log 2>&1; grep -qF "✓ exempted, a fixture literal built to differ" /tmp/p15r_exemption_stale.log
python3 tools/profile_definition/check_fixtures.py --abi-pins > /tmp/p15r_fixture_equal_guard.log 2>&1; grep -qF "✓ exempted, a fixture literal built to differ" /tmp/p15r_fixture_equal_guard.log

bash .agent/projects/031_system_one_decisions/evidence/P1.1/p11_core_check.sh test src/eval/journal/admission.ail > /tmp/p15r_fixture_equal_a9b.log 2>&1; grep -qF "p11: test src/eval/journal/admission.ail ok" /tmp/p15r_fixture_equal_a9b.log
python3 tools/profile_definition/check_fixtures.py --abi-pins > /tmp/p15r_pin_reverted.log 2>&1; grep -qF "✓ every manifest ABI pin in the tree is the declared one: 8.0" /tmp/p15r_pin_reverted.log
